messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning a quiet rollout of inference-service v2 today 18:00 UTC. Goal: gradual canary (not an emergency). Plan is: 1% global -> 5% (regional buckets) -> 20% (select enterprise accounts). Timeline roughly 0m / +30m / +90m. Need deploy owner, smoke owner, and someone to call rollback if signals break. Who can take which role?

alex: I can be deploy owner and kick things off at 18:00 UTC. I'll be on call and monitoring during the ramp.

jun: Thanks — can you confirm the smoke checklist? I'll be smoke owner if needed. Quick ask: what exact traffic-shift command will you use so I can run smoke locally against the canary?

maya: Good Q. Smoke checklist (short):
- quick healthcheck for /live and /ready
- sample inference against control prompts (latency + correctness)
- tail logs for obvious 5xx spikes
- check token consumption for the new runtime path

Smoke command snippets:```bash
# shift 1% to v2
redwoodctl traffic shift --service inference-service --to-version v2 --percent 1
# smoke probe (example)
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke: hello"}' | jq .
```

tia: I can run the smoke probes and watch the latency/cost dashboard (Grafana: infra/inference-slo). I'll post quick screenshots/notes in this thread.

leah: Are we gating 5% by region? Suggest splitting 5% into eu-west (2%), us-east (2%), ap-slice (1%) so we can halt only a region if needed. Also recommend holding autoscaler min nodes +1 during the ramp.

ops-oncall: Confirmed — I'll bump the autoscaler min for the cluster during the window and monitor node churn. If autoscaler starts to oscillate, I'll pause further percent increases.

alex: Rollback steps in brief (if needed):
1) redwoodctl traffic shift --service inference-service --to-version v1 --percent 100
2) mark v2 as failed in deployment tracker and open a rollback PR if needed
3) escalate to eng-oncall and sig-runtime

jun: What's our hard stop for errors/latency? Propose: pause and rollback if 5xx rate > 3% for 10m OR p95 latency increases > 2x baseline for 10m. Anyone object?

tia: +1 to those thresholds. I'll watch alerts: infra/inference-5xx and infra/inference-p95. I'll also post an immediate :rotating_light: here if thresholds cross.

sre-bot: preflight checks: config lint OK, canary image build passed, canary smoke suite (fast) passed locally. CI build: 202 OK.

maya: OK — plan locked. Owners: alex (deploy), tia (smoke/metrics), jun (rollback decision backup), ops-oncall (infra adjustments). Deployment starts 18:00 UTC, I'll do a quick preflight ping 10m before. If anyone needs to opt-out, call it now. :thumbsup:

alex: On it. Will ping at 17:50 UTC with final go/no-go.

jun: I'll be monitoring logs and ready to hold the ramp.

leah: I'll standby to throttle regional gating if we see a problem.

ops-oncall: Autoscaler bumped, alert hooks in place.

maya: Thanks team — posting runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/inference-v2-rollout — use that for escalation steps. Moving to prep; see you at 17:50.

tia: 👍 will post smoke results after each % step in this thread.
